{{Quote|Wow! That's some fancy footwork!|Fode Annodue, commenting on the dancer's performance|<ref name="AS" />}}
A [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] '''dancer''' performed a dance number at the [[Podracers' hovel]] on<ref name="AS" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="AS" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. During that time,<ref name="Timeline">''[[Star Wars: Anakin's Speedway]]'' is set during the events of {{Film|I}}, equating to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Fode, the left head of the bicephalic [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] commentator [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]], expressed admiration for the Gamorrean's dancing skills.<ref name="AS" />

Although heavily built, the Gamorrean was graceful and skilled enough to dance with their full weight resting on the tiptoes of a single [[Limb/Legends|foot]]. While on Tatooine, they wore [[Leather/Legends|leather]] and [[Hair/Legends|fur]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with metallic epaulets and armbands. The Gamorrean paired the outfit with shoes featuring pointy tips and ribbons. They had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin.<ref name="AS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gamorrean debuted in ''[[Star Wars: Anakin's Speedway]]'', a [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[Lucas Learning]].<ref name="AS" />
